preamble: This puzzle is a double grid, for which the following instructions apply to both grids. The puzzle has as its theme the complete oeuvre (in this genre) of one who is named in one of the longest solutions. Clues which are marked E (English), F (French), G (German), or I (Italian) lead to solutions which consist of a word that is hidden in the title of one of the works. (17 and 22 down is a complete title.) Other clues are normal.
